sections.body: We learn about the world with our five senses! 🌍
We SEE with our eyes. 👀 We HEAR with our ears. 👂
We SMELL with our nose. 👃 We TASTE with our tongue. 👅
We TOUCH and feel with our skin, like our fingers. ✋
Close your eyes. What can you hear right now?
Play 'I spy' and 'what's that sound?'. Name the sense each time: 'You used your ears!'. Never ask a child to taste unknown things to test their senses.

quiz.q: What do we use to HEAR music? 🎵
hints: Which part of your head do you cover when it's too loud?
We SEE with our eyes 👀. Now think: what do we HEAR with?

quiz.q: What do we use to TASTE ice cream? 🍦
hints: What part of your mouth touches the ice cream?
We SMELL with our nose 👃. What do we TASTE with?
